title: scaphium lychnophorum
intro: Scaphium lychnophorum, commonly known as the 'Butter Tree', is a medicinal plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Scaphium lychnophorum include its use as an antipyretic and anti-arthritic agent, making it a sought-after remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
